node.title: Unable to set the recent date from hash of array of hashes.
node.author: chandantul
node.doctext:

I have following data structure in my hash but i will need only one entry for the date and time which is more recent among all the respective keys and values but i am 2 values - one min and maximum. I will need one value instead. How i can achieve?
